tasks.label: ТВОЯ РОЛЬ
tasks.q: Лорд Нед наказав тобі супроводжувати Сансу на турнірі й записувати, хто перемагає. Санса засипає тебе питаннями, Мізинець підсідає поруч зі своїми історіями, а ввечері лорд хоче знати все: хто що питав, хто що наказував.
tasks.q_pl: Lord Ned kazał ci towarzyszyć Sansie na turnieju i zapisywać, kto wygrywa. Sansa zasypuje cię pytaniami, Littlefinger przysiada się ze swoimi historiami, a wieczorem lord chce wiedzieć wszystko: kto o co pytał i kto co rozkazywał.
tasks.q_en: Lord Ned has ordered you to escort Sansa at the tourney and record who wins. Sansa bombards you with questions, Littlefinger sits down beside you with his stories, and in the evening your lord wants to know everything: who asked what, and who ordered what.

tasks.label: ПРАВИЛО
tasks.q: Reported yes/no questions use if or whether: “Is Loras riding?” → She asked if Loras was riding. Wh- questions keep the question word but use normal word order (no do/did): “Where did he get his scars?” → She asked where he had got his scars. Commands and requests use tell / ask / order + person + (not) to + verb: “Sit down!” → He told me to sit down. “Don't look!” → She asked me not to look.
tasks.q_pl: Reported yes/no questions use if or whether: “Is Loras riding?” → She asked if Loras was riding. Wh- questions keep the question word but use normal word order (no do/did): “Where did he get his scars?” → She asked where he had got his scars. Commands and requests use tell / ask / order + person + (not) to + verb: “Sit down!” → He told me to sit down. “Don't look!” → She asked me not to look.
tasks.q_en: Reported yes/no questions use if or whether: “Is Loras riding?” → She asked if Loras was riding. Wh- questions keep the question word but use normal word order (no do/did): “Where did he get his scars?” → She asked where he had got his scars. Commands and requests use tell / ask / order + person + (not) to + verb: “Sit down!” → He told me to sit down. “Don't look!” → She asked me not to look.

end_good.title: Місію виконано!
end_good.text: Нед уважно слухає й несподівано всміхається. «Отже, Пес захистив лицаря, якого міг би вбити. Цікаво… Іноді найгірші люди роблять найкращі речі». Він записує щось у свою книгу.
end_good.text_pl: Ned słucha uważnie i nagle się uśmiecha. „A więc Ogar obronił rycerza, którego mógłby zabić. Ciekawe… Czasem najgorsi ludzie robią najlepsze rzeczy”. Zapisuje coś w swojej księdze.
end_good.text_en: Ned listens carefully and suddenly smiles. “So the Hound protected a knight he could have killed. Interesting… Sometimes the worst men do the best things.” He writes something in his book.
